title: Draft local-first fleet operations model
purpose: Prepare fleet operations concepts without turning Console Beta into a GA fleet manager.
scope: Define local-first node identity, node state and rollout target concepts.
Define what remains single-node in Console Beta.
Define future fleet authority boundaries and non-goals.
Define local proof requirements before remote fleet work.
acceptance_criteria: Single-node local proof remains complete without remote services.
Remote commands cannot bypass local AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
Rollout and rollback authorities are documented.
failure_modes: Fleet preview implies remote production readiness.
Remote operator authority bypasses local policy.
